item.title: Salsa Thursdays at Time Out Market — Thu Aug 6, 7:00 PM — Time Out Market New York
item.description:
Join us for one of NYC’s best free salsa nights and turn your Thursday into a dance-floor celebration.
Get your salsa on every Thursday night at Time Out Market New York! Head up to the fifth floor for an electrifying evening of rhythm, movement, and Latin vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or a seasoned dancer, this is your weekly excuse to move, sweat, and smile. Starting at 7:30 PM, renowned instructor Marlene Veras will guide you through the steps, breaking down the fundamentals so you feel confident on the dance floor. The night is powered by infectious beats from DJ Ray Suave, with live percussion by Jessica La Timbalera, setting the stage for a high-energy salsa experience. item.title: What's the Worst That Can Happen?: Writing Dystopian Fiction With Rachel A. Rosen — Sat Aug 8, 2:30 PM — Lillian H. Smith
item.description: From classics like Margaret Atwood’s Handmaid’s Tale to modern takes such as Cherie Dimaline’s The Marrow Thieves or Catherine Hernandez’s Crosshairs , dystopian fiction is a mainstay of Canadian sci-fi and fantasy. Why do we seek out cautionary tales when the real world is already so bleak? And how can prospective writers of dystopian speculative fiction write believable, immersive worlds? Join us for a creative writing workshop hosted by Aurora Award nominee and author, Rachel A. Rosen! Through a series of activities and guided exercises, participants will develop a literary toolbox to deepen their world-building and generate ideas for their own writing. Hosted by the Merril Collection of Science Fiction, Speculation & Fantasy This event is intended for audiences age 18 and up. Please register for this event on our website as space is limited. item.title: 🌿🌊 TORONTO ISLANDS SUMMER WALK (9KM) 🌊🌿 — Sun Aug 9, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🌿🌊 TORONTO ISLANDS SUMMER WALK (9KM) 🌊🌿
### Island Paths, Skyline Views & Toronto's Best Urban Escape
There is something magical about the Toronto Islands. Just minutes from downtown, the noise of the city disappears and is replaced by tree-lined paths, open green spaces, quiet cottages, and some of the best skyline views anywhere in Toronto. It feels like you've escaped the city without ever leaving it.
Join us for a relaxed summer walk across the Toronto Islands as we explore **Hanlan's Point, Centre Island, and Ward's Island**, enjoying beautiful scenery, fresh air, and great conversation along the way.
The Toronto Islands have a fascinating history. Originally connected to the mainland as a long sandbar peninsula, a powerful storm in 1858 permanently separated the land from Toronto, creating the islands we know today. item.description:
Leadership does not start when you become a manager or director. It starts with how you show up at work every day. In this workshop, participants will explore what it means to act like a leader early in their career through confidence, professionalism, communication, and accountability. En esta sesión conectaremos un agente al endpoint remoto de Fabric (https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/v1/mcp/core), exploraremos cómo se autentica via Entra ID y RBAC, y ejecutaremos operaciones reales: crear workspaces, gestionar permisos, hacer CRUD de ítems y definiciones, todo con trazabilidad completa en los audit logs.
También veremos los controles de seguridad incorporados — cómo las operaciones destructivas se marcan como is_consequential y cómo el agente pide confirmación antes de actuar.
Asegúrate de tener permisos de contribuidor en al menos un workspace de Fabric para el lab en vivo.
